headword: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}

definitions.explanation: Driving a vehicle carefully and in accordance with traffic rules to avoid accidents. A common term in traffic safety campaigns and driving education.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけて→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧{安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Safe driving is especially important on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}{講習|こうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついた。
examples.english: Thanks to taking a safe driving course, I gained confidence in driving.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard compound seen on road signs, in driving schools, and in public safety campaigns. Often used with ⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧ (to keep in mind) or ⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧ (to ensure thoroughly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧ (to practice safe driving)
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}{講習|こうしゅう} (safe driving course)
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧ (obligation to drive safely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: driving — general term
- ⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: dangerous driving — the opposite
